title: On the Idiosyncrasies of the Mandarin Chinese Classifier System
abstract: arXiv:1902.10193v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While idiosyncrasies of the Chinese classifier system have been a richly studied topic among linguists (Adams and Conklin, 1973; Erbaugh, 1986; Lakoff, 1986), not much work has been done to quantify them with statistical methods. In this paper, we introduce an information-theoretic approach to measuring idiosyncrasy; we examine how much the uncertainty in Mandarin Chinese classifiers can be reduced by knowing semantic information about the nouns that the classifiers modify. Using the empirical distribution of classifiers from the parsed Chinese Gigaword corpus (Graff et al., 2005), we compute the mutual information (in bits) between the distribution over classifiers and distributions over other linguistic quantities. translated_title: 论普通话量词系统的独特性
translated_abstract: 虽然汉语量词系统的独特性一直是语言学家们广泛研究的课题（Adams和Conklin，1973；Erbaugh，1986；Lakoff，1986），但用统计方法对其进行量化的研究却不多。在本文中，我们引入了一种信息论方法来衡量独特性；我们考察了通过了解量词所修饰名词的语义信息，普通话量词中的不确定性能在多大程度上被降低。利用解析后的中文Gigaword语料库（Graff等，2005）中量词的经验分布，我们计算了量词分布与其他语言量分布之间的互信息（以比特为单位）。我们研究了名词和形容词的语义类别在降低量词选择不确定性方面是否存在差异，并发现这并非完全独特的；虽然对于大多数类别没有明显的趋势，但结果揭示了语义信息在量词选择中的系统性作用。
tldr: 本文通过信息论方法量化了普通话量词系统的独特性，发现语义信息能显著降低量词选择的不确定性，表明该系统并非完全任意。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the idiosyncrasies of the Mandarin classifier system using an information-theoretic approach, finding that semantic information significantly reduces classifier choice uncertainty, indicating the system is not entirely arbitrary.
